question.text: The magnifying power of a telescope is 9 . When it is adjusted for parallel rays, the distance between the objective and eyepiece is 20 cm . The ratio of focal length of objective lens to focal length of eyepiece is found to be $m$, then the value of $m$ is

solution.text:
Magnifying power of telescope,m = 9
$\begin{array}{ll}
\Rightarrow & \frac{f_0}{f_e}=9 \\
\Rightarrow & f_0=9 f_e \ldots(i)
\end{array}$
Distance between objective and eyepiece is given as
$\begin{aligned}
& f_0+f_e=20 \ldots(ii)\\
& \Rightarrow \quad 9 f_e+f_e=20 \\
& \text { [from Eq. (i)] } \\
& \Rightarrow \quad 10 f_e=20 \\
& \Rightarrow \quad f_e=2 \mathrm{~cm}
\end{aligned}$
$\begin{aligned} & \therefore \text { From Eq. (i), } f_0=9 \times 2=18 \mathrm{~cm} \\ & \therefore \quad \frac{f_0}{f_e}=\frac{18}{2}=9\end{aligned}$
